title: Multi-scale light microscopy and electron microscopy neuronal imaging in mouse brain tissue
author: Yamauchi, Furuta, et al.

steps.title: Prepare 11.16% PFA Fixative
steps.instruction: Make 100 mL of 11.16 % (w/v) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in distilled deionized water (ddH₂O). Warm ~80 mL ddH₂O to 70‑80 °C, add 16 g PFA, dissolve by adding 2‑3 drops of 10 N NaOH, cool to 20‑25 °C and bring volume to 100 mL with ddH₂O, filter through filter paper, dispense into 10 mL aliquots and store at –20 °C (stable for 6 months).

substeps.instruction: Warm ~80 mL ddH₂O to 70‑80 °C.
Add 16 g PFA to the warmed water.
Add 2‑3 drops of 10 N NaOH to dissolve PFA.
Cool solution to 20‑25 °C and bring to 100 mL with ddH₂O.
Filter through filter paper.
Dispense into 10 mL aliquots.
Store at –20 °C (up to 6 months).

steps.title: Assemble 3D‑Printed Imaging Chamber
steps.instruction: Print the chamber frame (or order via an online 3D‑printing service), then secure the printed frame to a bottom coverslip using a pressure‑sensitive adhesive; the assembled chamber can be mounted directly on a microscope stage using the provided stage adaptors.

substeps.instruction: Obtain or 3D‑print the chamber frame.
Secure the printed frame to the bottom coverslip with pressure‑sensitive adhesive.

steps.title: Coat Slides with Siliconized L‑25
steps.instruction: Prepare a 5 % (v/v) siliconized solution by mixing 500 µL Siliconized L‑25 with 9.5 mL chloroform, spread the solution onto glass slides and coverslips, and allow them to dry completely.

substeps.instruction: Mix 500 µL Siliconized L‑25 with 9.5 mL chloroform and stir well.
Spread the resulting 5 % solution onto glass slides and coverslips.
Let the coated slides and coverslips dry.

steps.title: Prepare Resin Rocket
steps.instruction: Combine 3.8 mL Luveak‑812, 2 mL Luveak‑DDSA and 2.4 mL Luveak‑MNA, stir slowly for 5 min; add 0.12 mL Luveak‑DMP‑30 and stir for 30 min; pour the mixture into silicon capsules and polymerize in an oven at 60 °C for 2 days. Store the polymerized resin at 20‑25 °C for several years.

substeps.instruction: Mix 3.8 mL Luveak‑812, 2 mL Luveak‑DDSA and 2.4 mL Luveak‑MNA, stirring slowly for 5 min.
Add 0.12 mL Luveak‑DMP‑30 and stir slowly for 30 min.
Transfer mixture to silicon capsules and polymerize at 60 °C for 2 days.
Store the cured resin at 20‑25 °C.

steps.title: Sacrifice Mice and Perfuse Fixative
steps.instruction: Euthanize mice previously injected with AAV2/1‑SynTetOff‑EGFP‑APEX2 by intraperitoneal overdose of Somnopentyl® (200 mg/kg), then perform perfusion fixation in a fume hood: open thoracic cavity, incise right atrial appendage, insert a 22‑gauge needle into the left ventricle, perfuse 20 mL ice‑cold PBS followed by 20 mL ice‑cold fixative solution using separate 20 mL syringes.

substeps.instruction: Inject mice with Somnopentyl® (200 mg/kg, IP) to achieve overdose.
Open thoracic cavity with surgical scissors.
Make incision to right atrial appendage.
Insert 22‑gauge needle into left ventricle.
Perfuse 20 mL ice‑cold PBS with a 20 mL syringe.
Perfuse 20 mL ice‑cold fixative solution with a second 20 mL syringe.

steps.title: Post‑fix Brain Tissue
steps.instruction: Excise the brain with scissors and tweezers, keep samples protected from light, then immerse the brain in the same fixative solution and rock gently at 4 °C for 16‑20 h (50‑100 rpm). Proceed immediately to the next step; do not store for extended periods.

substeps.instruction: Excise brains using surgical scissors and tweezers.
Protect samples from light.
Immerse brains in fixative solution and rock gently at 4 °C for 16‑20 h (50‑100 rpm).

steps.title: Embed Brain in Agar and Section
steps.instruction: Embed each fixed brain in 4 % agar in PBS (agar at 40‑45 °C) in a 6‑well plate, solidify on ice for 30 min, then set up the vibratome: fill bath with crushed ice, tape the specimen tray, attach tray, trim agar block, mount block with superglue, add ice‑cold 0.1 M PB, set sectioning speed to 0.14 mm/s with 1.4 mm amplitude, frequency to 75‑77 Hz, cut 1‑mm‑thick slices, and collect slices in ice‑cold PBS (store up to 16‑20 h at 4 °C, avoiding NaN₃).

substeps.instruction: Embed brain in 4 % agar in PBS in a 6‑well plate (agar at 40‑45 °C).
Solidify agar on ice for 30 min.
Fill vibratome bath with crushed ice.
Place a piece of mending tape on the bottom of the specimen tray.
Attach the tray to the bath.
Trim the agar block with a razor blade to square the sides.
Mount the agar block onto the tape with superglue.
Pour ice‑cold 0.1 M phosphate buffer onto the tray.
Set vibratome speed to 0.14 mm/s with 1.4 mm amplitude.
Set vibratome frequency to 75‑77 Hz.
Cut 1‑mm‑thick brain slices.
Collect slices in ice‑cold PBS; slices may be stored in PBS for 16‑20 h at 4 °C. Avoid NaN₃.
